messages.author: Kenji Nakamura
messages.text: Certificates: CERT-7880 lists the manifold at rev D — invalidated. CERT-7892 covers the size 2 unit through its own port block and survives. 7871 is superseded; 7860 expired in March.

messages.author: Sören Lindqvist
messages.text: A validity extension for 7860 would be my call and nobody has asked me. Not pre-approved.

messages.author: Célia Baptiste
messages.text: Line 2 AM on the 20th is the audit freeze — do not move anything into it. The rev E fixtures on SO-8800 land the 19th.
